## Funding and awards

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_web_tarjetas(c(
  lapply(web("funding"), function(e) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "coins", paste("Funding ·", cv_periodo(e$start, e$end)),
    sprintf("**%s** %s, %s (%s), %s. *%s*", e$name, e$code %||% "", e$funder,
            e$funder_short %||% "", e$country, e$project %||% ""),
    nota = e$amount
  )),
  lapply(web("awards"), function(e) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "award", paste("Award ·", cv_periodo(e$date)),
    cv_punto(paste0("**", e$title, "**", if (!is.null(e$context)) paste(" at the", e$context)))
  ))
))
```

## Service to the community

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_web_tarjetas(list(
  if (length(web("organization"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "calendar-check", "Event organization",
    cv_web_lista(vapply(web("organization"), function(e) {
      sprintf("%s (%s): %s", e$event, cv_periodo(e$date), tolower(e$role))
    }, ""))
  ),
  if (length(cv$reviews)) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "eye", "Peer review",
    cv_punto(paste(vapply(cv$reviews, function(r) sprintf("*%s* (%s)", r$journal, r$count), ""),
                   collapse = ", "))
  ),
  if (length(web("memberships"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "users", "Memberships",
    vapply(web("memberships"), function(e) {
      nombre <- if (is.null(e$url)) e$name else sprintf("[%s](%s)", e$name, e$url)
      paste0(paste(c(nombre, e$full_name, e$role), collapse = ", "),
             " (since ", e$since, ").\n")
    }, "")
  ),
  if (length(web("workshops"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "people-group", "Workshops",
    vapply(web("workshops"), function(e) {
      cv_punto(paste0(if (!is.null(e$role)) paste(e$role, "in "), "**", e$title, "**",
                      if (!is.null(e$description)) paste0(": ", e$description),
                      " (", cv_periodo(e$date), ")"))
    }, "")
  )
))
```

## Training, skills and languages

```{r}
#| output: asis
habilidades <- unlist(lapply(cv$skills$technical, function(g) g$items))
cv_web_tarjetas(list(
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "graduation-cap", "Courses",
    cv_web_lista(vapply(web("courses"), function(e) {
      paste0(e$title, if (!is.null(e$org)) paste0(", ", e$org), " (", cv_periodo(e$date), ")")
    }, ""))
  ),
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "screwdriver-wrench", "Skills",
    paste0("::: cv-chips\n", paste(sprintf("[%s]{.cv-chip}", habilidades), collapse = " "), "\n:::")
  ),
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "language", "Languages",
    paste(vapply(cv$skills$languages, function(l) {
      sprintf("**%s**: %s", l$language, cv_nivel_idioma(l$level, l$label))
    }, ""), collapse = "<br>")
  ),
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "address-book", "References",
    cv_web_lista(vapply(web("references"), function(r) {
      sprintf("**%s** — %s, %s", r$name, r$role, r$org_short %||% r$org)
    }, "")),
    nota = "Contact details in the [PDF](cv.pdf) or on request."
  )
))
```
